services.title: International Sourcing
services.summary: Finding and working with suitable suppliers beyond your own market, with the process kept structured from brief to follow-up.
body: International sourcing means looking past the suppliers you already know to find ones that fit your requirement better, whether on specification, capacity, lead time or cost.

We take your requirement, research the relevant markets, identify suppliers worth talking to and manage the communication with them, so you see organised options rather than a pile of unanswered enquiries.
audience: Businesses looking for a product or material not readily available locally
Teams comparing suppliers across more than one market
Companies without the time or contacts to run supplier searches themselves
handle: Clarifying the requirement: specification, quantity, standard and timeline
Researching markets and identifying suitable suppliers
First contact, questions and quotation requests
Organising responses so options can be compared side by side
Following up until a decision is made
services.approach: We treat every search as a small project: a written requirement, a defined shortlist and regular updates. You make the decisions; we make sure you have what you need to make them.
expect: A written summary of your requirement before any search starts
Organised supplier options with the information you asked for
Regular updates through one point of contact
Clear notes on what is confirmed and what is still open

faqs.q: Do you guarantee a supplier will be found?
faqs.a: No. We commit to a structured search and honest reporting. If suitable options are limited, we tell you what we found and why.

faqs.q: Who decides which supplier to use?
faqs.a: You do. We present the options and the information behind them; the decision stays with your business.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: A description of the product or material, the quantity, any quality standard, and the date you need it by. Drawings, samples or reference links help.

services.title: Product & Supplier Sourcing
services.summary: Looking for products and suppliers that match your specification, budget and timeline, and coordinating samples where needed.
body: Product and supplier sourcing starts from a specific item. We review what you need, look for suppliers able to make or supply it, and help you compare them on the points that matter to your business.
Where samples are part of the decision, we help coordinate requesting, tracking and reviewing them.
audience: Brands developing or re-sourcing a product
Businesses that need a specific component, material or finished item
Buyers who want a second option alongside a current supplier
handle: Reviewing the specification and asking the questions suppliers will ask
Shortlisting suppliers able to meet the specification
Requesting and organising quotations
Coordinating sample requests and feedback
Keeping a record of what each supplier has confirmed
services.approach: We compare suppliers on more than price. Communication, consistency and the ability to meet your standard are weighed alongside cost and lead time.
expect: A clear specification both sides can work from
A shortlist with the reasons behind it
Quotations organised in one comparable format
Sample status tracked until review is complete

faqs.q: Can you work from a photo or a reference product?
faqs.a: Yes, as a starting point. We will then help turn it into a written specification suppliers can quote against.
We coordinate sample requests, follow up on them and help organise feedback. Arrangements for each requirement are agreed in advance.

services.title: Business Coordination
services.summary: Acting as one organised point of contact between the parties involved in your requirement.
body: Many requirements involve several parties: suppliers, partners, service providers and your own team. Business coordination keeps them connected and working from the same information.
We follow up on messages and meetings, keep track of what has been agreed, and report status back to you.
audience: Businesses managing several external parties on one requirement
Teams that need someone to own follow-up
Partners working across time zones or languages
handle: Connecting the relevant parties
Scheduling and following up on meetings and messages
Recording agreed actions and owners
Chasing open items before they become delays
Regular status updates to you
services.approach: One point of contact, one shared record of what has been agreed, and follow-up that happens on a schedule rather than when something goes wrong.
expect: A named point of contact
A running list of agreed actions and their status
Prompt follow-up on open items
Updates at an agreed frequency

faqs.q: Do you replace our own team?
faqs.a: No. We support your team by owning the coordination work, so your people can focus on decisions.

faqs.q: How often will I get updates?
faqs.a: We agree the frequency with you at the start, and update sooner when something needs your attention.

services.title: Sourcing Support
services.summary: Helping your team turn a loose requirement into a clear, trackable sourcing workflow.
body: Sometimes the need is not a new search but a better way of working. Sourcing support helps your team document requirements, set up a simple workflow and track progress.
It suits businesses that already source in-house but want more structure around it.
audience: Businesses that already source but want a clearer process
Growing teams handling more requirements than before
Owners who want visibility of where each requirement stands
handle: Documenting requirements in a consistent format
Setting up a simple workflow from request to delivery
Tracking progress on open requirements
Organising supplier information in one place
services.approach: We start with how your team works today and add only the structure that helps. The aim is a process people actually use.
expect: A requirement template suited to your business
A clear view of open requirements and their status
Practical recommendations, not a heavy system

faqs.a: Not necessarily. We work with the tools your team already uses wherever possible.

services.title: Business Solutions
services.summary: Structured support shaped around a specific business requirement that does not fit a standard service.
body: Not every requirement fits a category. Business solutions is how we handle those: we assess the need, agree a plan and support its execution.
The same principles apply as in our other services: a written scope, a clear process and regular communication.
audience: Businesses with a requirement that crosses several areas
Teams that need practical support on an operational problem
Anyone unsure which of our services fits
handle: Understanding the business need and its constraints
Agreeing a written scope and plan
Supporting execution against that plan
Reviewing the result against the original need
services.approach: We scope before we commit. If a requirement is outside what we can do well, we say so early.
expect: An honest assessment of whether we are the right fit
A written scope before work begins
Regular communication throughout

faqs.q: What if my requirement doesn't match any listed service?
faqs.a: Describe it in the request form. We will review it and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.

services.title: International Business Support
services.summary: Keeping cross-border coordination organised and communication clear, where applicable.
body: Working across borders adds distance, time zones and different ways of doing business. International business support helps keep that coordination organised.
We help maintain communication with partners in other markets and follow up so that agreed steps move forward.
audience: Businesses working with partners in other countries
International partners working with businesses in Bangladesh
Teams managing a cross-border requirement for the first time
handle: Coordinating communication between parties in different markets
Following up on agreed steps and documents
Keeping a shared record of progress
Flagging issues early so they can be resolved
services.approach: Clear written communication and a steady follow-up rhythm, so distance does not become delay.
expect: One accountable point of contact
Written summaries of discussions and agreed steps
Regular progress updates

faqs.q: Which countries do you work with?
faqs.a: We review each requirement individually. Tell us the markets involved and we will confirm whether we can support it.
